description: instagram: Reels. GET /v1/instagram/user/reels. Get the first 12 reels on a public profile's reels tab, each with play, like and comment counts, code, URL, cover image and date. Only the first 12 are available signed out: paging_info.max_id is always null and passing max_id returns 400. Captions are not on the reels tab; /v1/instagram/post has them. Requires handle: a lookup by user_id needs a login and returns 400. Post dates (taken_at, taken_at_timestamp, create Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

handle.description: The Instagram username, with or without @ (required)

max_id.description: Not supported: signed-out pagination is closed, so only the first 12 reels are returned. Passing one returns 400.

require_play_counts.description: Set to true to fail (at 0 credits) instead of returning a reel without a play count.

trim.description: Set to true for a trimmed response.

user_id.description: Not supported: a lookup by user_id needs a login. Pass handle; user_id alone returns 400.

name: instagram_user_reels
